title: The Dancing Idli | Fun Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
A fat white idli wakes up, bounces on the plate, and dances in the sambar, while a sneaky brother tries to hide his food.
This playful song teaches kids that trying new foods can be fun, and that sharing and tasting something new can lead to yum, yum surprises.
Sing along and enjoy the silly bounce!

Amma opens up the steamer
Puff, puff, puff, out comes the steam
A fat white idli, yawn, yawn, yawn
"Good morning, friends!" says the idli

Boing, boing, bounce goes the idli
Bouncing on the plate, bounce, bounce
Boing, boing, boing, boing
Eat me while I'm hot!

Brother hides his plate, sneaky, sneaky
"I want chips, not idli!" he says
Hide, hide, hide, hide
Oh no, the idli can see you!

Boing, boing, bounce goes the idli
Bouncing on the plate, bounce, bounce
Boing, boing, boing, boing
Eat me while I'm hot!

Idli dips into the sambar
Splash, splash, sambar fun
Spin, spin, spin, spin
Dance, dance, dance, dance, what a show!

Boing, boing, bounce goes the idli
Bouncing on the plate, bounce, bounce
Boing, boing, boing, boing
Eat me while I'm hot!

Brother takes a bite, yum, yum
"Amma, can I have two more?"
More, more, more, more
Hooray for the dancing idli!
